capability.summary: Return Git's textual --stat summary for unstaged tracked working-tree changes
capability.description: Runs `git -C <repo> diff --stat` for an optional repository path defaulting to the current directory. It reports the default working-tree-versus-index diff summary without changing repository state.
capability.problem_space: Read-only size summary of the default unstaged tracked-file diff in one repository; not patch retrieval, staged-change inspection, commit-range comparison, untracked-file discovery, or Git mutation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional existing repo_path string defaulting to `.`; output: JSON process envelope with raw `git diff --stat` stdout, stderr, and exit code.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory path
no argument to inspect the current working directory via the `.` default
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; stdout is Git's unparsed --stat text and may be empty when there are no unstaged tracked changes. Nonzero Git result uses the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagates Git's exit code. Non-existing path, missing executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. The optional argument defaults to `.` and therefore has no missing-argument usage failure.
limitations: uses plain `git diff --stat` with no `--cached`, revisions, pathspecs, numstat, patch, or caller-supplied flags
summarizes unstaged tracked-file differences between the working tree and index; staged-only and untracked changes are not represented
returns unparsed Git text in stdout with result=null and applies no output truncation
requires Git on PATH, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and never modifies repository state

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing unparsed `git diff --stat` text for unstaged tracked changes, plus target and process metadata.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: get a textual git diff --stat for a repository
negative_intents: inspect staged changes or compare commits and branches
retrieve a full Git patch or structured per-line diff
modify, stage, commit, reset, or clean repository files
